title: Analysis of Anterior Chamber Inflammation by Optical Coherence Tomography
official: Automated Analysis of Anterior Chamber Inflammation by Optical Coherence Tomography
summary: A prospective, observational, case series investigating the feasibility of utilizing OCT scans of the anterior chamber of eyes with uveitis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients presenting to Cole Eye Institute with uveitis.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to provide informed consent, including non-English speaking and cognitively/mentally impaired.
* Severe corneal opacities preventing imaging of anterior chamber
